The great finish of my very last evening in Da Nang
Mar 2020 • Solo
I was staying in the hotel next door and passing by this restaurant every day on my Da Nang visit. What impressed me was its nice atmosphere, live music and really kind staff. On my last night I finally decided to give this place a chance and I regret I haven't done it earlier. 
The sea food fried rice was delicious, big portion, nicely served. It was full with people, some of them guests of Sofia hotel, another sign this place is good. The service turned out to be excellent!
I would love to go again and even stay in the hotel!
Stefan/ Bulgaria
